The interior prioritizes comfort and convenience with eight-passenger seating configuration, cloth upholstery, and thoughtful amenities throughout. This 2022 Toyota Sienna XSE 7 Passenger delivers the practicality and comfort your family deserves with a well-balanced combination of efficiency and capability.

- Premium JBL Audio with Navigation and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto integration
- Power moonroof for added light and ventilation
- Front heated bucket seats with power adjustment
- Rear air conditioning with dual zone control
- Lane Departure Warning System for enhanced safety
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Exterior parking camera with rear view display
- Three rows of seating with split-folding rear seats
- 20-inch Dark Alloy wheels
- Auto High-beam Headlights with delay-off feature
- Automatic temperature control with front and rear zones
- Emergency communication system with Safety Connect (3-year trial)
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- HomeLink garage door transmitter

The Sienna's 2.5L four-cylinder engine with CVT transmission provides consistent power delivery while maintaining excellent fuel efficiency at 36 city and 36 highway miles per gallon. Whether navigating city streets or highway drives, this powertrain strikes a reliable balance between performance and economy. The front-wheel drive configuration enhances traction and stability across various driving conditions.

Comfort features extend throughout the cabin, where front dual zone air conditioning and rear dual zone climate control allow passengers to set their preferred temperatures independently. The power driver seat and heated front seats ensure that long trips remain enjoyable, while the reclining third-row seats provide flexibility for different passenger configurations and cargo needs.

Safety has been thoughtfully integrated into this model. Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and Lane Departure Warning System work together to help maintain vehicle stability and alert you to unintended lane departures. The comprehensive airbag system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and low tire pressure warning provide multiple layers of protection. The Safety Connect emergency communication system includes a three-year trial to help keep you connected in unexpected situations.

The exterior presents a distinguished appearance with the vibrant red finish complemented by body-color bumpers and 20-inch Dark Alloy wheels. Auto High-beam Headlights with delay-off functionality, front fog lights, and a power moonroof round out the exterior features, while the rear window wiper and variably intermittent wipers keep visibility optimal in all weather conditions.

This Sienna is ready to serve your family's transportation needs with proven Toyota reliability and thoughtful design. Visit our showroom to experience the comfort and capability this vehicle offers firsthand.

This 2022 Toyota Sienna XLE represents a smart choice for families and individuals seeking a versatile minivan with proven reliability and excellent fuel efficiency combined with practical comfort and safety.

- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Lane Departure Warning System
- Backup Camera

- Split Folding Rear Seat

The Sienna XLE delivers an impressive 36 MPG combined (36 city/36 highway), making it one of the most fuel-efficient minivans available today. Its white exterior paired with SofTex seat trim creates a clean, professional appearance both inside and out. The front heated bucket seats provide comfort during cold weather, while the power moonroof adds an open-air feel to your driving experience. The reclining third-row seat and split folding rear seat offer flexible interior configurations to accommodate passengers and cargo according to your needs.

Safety features have been prioritized throughout this vehicle. The Lane Departure Warning System helps keep you centered in your lane, while the backup camera assists with reversing maneuvers. Electronic Stability Control and ABS brakes work together to maintain traction and control in challenging conditions. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive occupant protection. The Low Tire Pressure Warning System alerts you to potential tire issues before they become problems.

This 2022 Sienna comes with comprehensive Toyota Gold Certified benefits including: Multipoint Inspection, Roadside Assistance, Warranty Deductible: $0, Transferable Warranty, Vehicle History, Limited Warranty: 12 Month/12,000 Mile Limited Comprehensive Warranty: 12 Month/12,000 Mile (whichever comes first) from certified purchase date, Powertrain Limited Warranty: 84 Month/100,000 Mile (whichever comes first) from TCUV purchase date, Roadside Assistance for 7 Year / 100,000 Mile. Standard New-Car Financing Rates Available. Warranty honored at over 1,400 Toyota dealers in the continental U.S. & Canada. Trade-ins accepted. Trouble-free handling of your transaction, including DMV paperwork.

Entertainment and convenience features enhance every journey. The Audio Plus system includes 8 speakers and SiriusXM capability, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keep your smartphone seamlessly connected. The HomeLink garage door transmitter allows keyless entry to your garage. Power controls include the driver and passenger seats, moonroof, and liftgate, streamlining daily operations.

Experience family-focused luxury with this 2023 Honda Odyssey Elite, a sophisticated minivan engineered to deliver comfort, safety, and convenience for every journey you take together.

- 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC 24V engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission
- 550-Watt AM/FM/HD Premium Audio System with 11 speakers and SiriusXM
- Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow
- Lane Keeping Assist System with Blind Spot Information warning
- Power Liftgate for easy cargo access
- Leather-trimmed heated front bucket seats with power adjustment
- Power Moonroof for premium light and ventilation
- Heated steering wheel and auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- 19" machine-finished alloy wheels
- Reclining third-row seat with split-folding rear configuration
- Rear backup camera for confident parking
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Emergency communication system: HondaLink

The Odyssey Elite combines practical functionality with refined appointments throughout. Heated front bucket seats and a heated steering wheel provide welcome comfort during cooler months, while front and rear dual-zone automatic climate control ensures every passenger rides at their preferred temperature. The power moonroof adds natural light and ventilation, creating an open atmosphere for your cabin experience.

Safety features work seamlessly to protect your family. Adaptive Cruise Control maintains your set distance from traffic ahead, Lane Keeping Assist helps you stay centered in your lane, and the Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and an emergency communication system through HondaLink provide comprehensive protection and peace of mind.

Entertainment and connectivity are seamlessly integrated. The 550-watt premium audio system delivers clear, rich sound through 11 strategically placed speakers, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep your smartphone integration intuitive and accessible. The Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System guides you efficiently, and rear audio controls empower back-seat passengers to enjoy their own entertainment experience.

Versatility defines the Odyssey Elite's interior design. The split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row seat adapt to your cargo and passenger needs, while the power liftgate opens with the touch of a button for convenient loading. With 45,352 miles, this vehicle has been thoughtfully maintained and remains a reliable choice for families seeking capable, comfortable transportation.

The Odyssey Elite delivers solid fuel economy at 19 mpg city and 28 mpg highway, balancing power and efficiency for your daily drives. This vehicle represents the practical elegance and family-oriented engineering that defines Honda's minivan legacy.

Power steering, speed-sensing steering adjustments, and four-wheel independent suspension create a responsive driving experience. The power moonroof adds an open-air feel to the cabin, while automatic headlights with delay-off and speed-sensitive wipers manage visibility automatically.

The infotainment system includes a 160-watt audio setup with AM/FM, HD, and SiriusXM capabilities, complemented by Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your attention focused on the road. Additional convenience features include the HomeLink garage door transmitter, illuminated entry, and an overhead console with multiple storage options.

This Odyssey Sport combines family practicality with modern convenience features, offering reliable transportation for everyday driving and weekend adventures.

- 7-passenger seating with heated leather front bucket seats
- Split-folding rear seat and reclining 3rd row seat for flexible cargo configuration
- Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System with Apple CarPlay/Android Auto

- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) active lane departure warning
- Blind Spot Information (BSI) System for enhanced visibility awareness

The Odyssey's 3.5L V6 engine delivers dependable performance paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission optimized for efficiency. With 19 city MPG and 28 highway MPG, this minivan balances power with reasonable fuel consumption for regular driving patterns.

Seating flexibility defines the Odyssey experience. The front bucket seats feature heating and premium leather trim, while the captain's chairs and reclining third-row bench accommodate seven passengers comfortably. The split-folding rear seat design enables customization between passenger space and cargo capacity, adapting to your changing needs throughout your day.

Climate control extends throughout the cabin with dual-zone automatic temperature regulation up front and independent rear air conditioning, ensuring comfort for all passengers regardless of seating position. The power moonroof adds natural light and a sense of openness to the interior environment.

Technology integration centers on the Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System paired with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, allowing seamless smartphone integration for navigation, music, and communication. The 160-Watt audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio delivers quality sound, while rear audio controls enable rear-seat passengers to participate in entertainment choices.

Safety features include Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow for highway driving, Lane Keeping Assist System for active lane departure prevention, and a Blind Spot Information System providing visual alerts. The rear-view camera assists with parking and reversing, while the comprehensive airbag system and HondaLink emergency communication add layers of protection.

This 2023 Honda Odyssey Touring offers the practical transportation, modern conveniences, and safety technology that families depend on. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the spacious interior, responsive handling, and thoughtful design that define this minivan's appeal.

- Uconnect 5 with 10.1" touchscreen display and smartphone integration
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility

- ParkSense Front and Rear Park Assist with automatic stopping
- Heated and power-adjustable front seats with memory function
- Automatic climate control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning
- Heated steering wheel for comfort

Caprice leatherette bucket seats in the front rows provide support during daily commutes, while the heated front seats and memory function ensure each driver finds their ideal position. Climate zones keep occupants comfortable regardless of their seating position.

Technology integration makes this Pacifica Hybrid exceptionally user-friendly. The Uconnect 5 system with its large 10.1-inch touchscreen puts navigation, entertainment, and vehicle controls at your fingertips. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity means your smartphone becomes an extension of the vehicle's capabilities. The 360 surround view camera system with park assist features transforms parking into a straightforward task, while SiriusXM satellite radio keeps entertainment options virtually unlimited.

Safety has been engineered throughout this vehicle's structure. The Safety Sphere package includes six airbags strategically positioned to protect occupants. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain vehicle composure in challenging driving conditions. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power, and the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about your vehicle's status.

Driving this Pacifica Hybrid means accessing a vehicle purpose-built for families who value efficiency alongside capability. The hybrid powertrain balances fuel economy with the power needed for daily family responsibilities. Power-operated mirrors, doors, and windows simplify everyday operation, while the power-adjustable steering wheel accommodates drivers of different heights. Automatic temperature control and rear air conditioning ensure all passengers stay comfortable.

This 2023 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid represents a smart choice for families seeking reliability, modern technology, and practical design combined in one vehicle.

This 2018 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L Plus offers the practicality and comfort your family deserves, with a refined design and thoughtful features that make every journey more convenient.

- Tire & Wheel Group with Michelin Brand Tires and 18" Painted Aluminum Wheels
- Uconnect 4C Navigation System with 8.4" Touchscreen Display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- DVD-Audio System with 13 Speakers and SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Heated Front and Rear Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Perforated Leather Trim Bucket Seats with Toffee Accents
- Power Liftgate
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Dual Front Zone Automatic Climate Control with Rear Air Conditioning
- Roof Rack
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with Fog Lights
- GPS Navigation with Voice Command
- Emergency Communication System: Uconnect Access

Powered by a 3.6L V6 engine paired with a 9-Speed Automatic transmission, this Pacifica delivers capable performance combined with reasonable fuel economy at 19 city and 28 highway mpg. The front-wheel drive system ensures confident handling in various driving conditions, while the touring suspension provides a smooth, composed ride quality suited for family travels.

The interior showcases premium touches throughout, including perforated leather trim bucket seats and a heated steering wheel for those colder months. Climate control extends to all three rows with front dual zone automatic temperature adjustment and rear air conditioning, ensuring every passenger travels in comfort. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading, while the reclining third row seats and split folding rear configuration offer flexibility for cargo or passengers.

Technology integration is seamless with the Uconnect 4C Navigation system featuring an 8.4" touchscreen display, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and full smartphone compatibility through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Stay connected with SiriusXM Satellite Radio, including a one-year Guardian Trial, plus SiriusXM Traffic Plus and Travel Link services for enhanced navigation awareness.

Safety is comprehensively addressed with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. Additional safety systems include Electronic Stability Control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, brake assist, and the ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera to enhance visibility during reversing. A low tire pressure warning system and security system complete the protective features.

The Silver exterior is finished with body-color bumpers, heated power door mirrors, bodyside moldings, and a roof rack for additional versatility. Auto High-Beam Headlights, front fog lights, and rain-sensing wipers enhance visibility and driver confidence in changing weather conditions.

This 2018 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L Plus is ready to serve your family's transportation needs with the combination of comfort, technology, and safety you expect from a modern family vehicle. We invite you to schedule a personal viewing and test drive to fully appreciate what this minivan has to offer.

The 2022 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid Limited combines family versatility with modern efficiency, offering a practical solution for those seeking dependable transportation in a well-appointed minivan.

- Uconnect 5 Navigation system with 10.1 display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Harman/Kardon premium speaker system with 20 speakers
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- Power moonroof
- Premium leather trim bucket seats with heating and ventilation
- Heated steering wheel
- Power liftgate with convenient operation
- Three-row seating with split-folding configuration
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Rear backup camera for enhanced visibility
- Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- All-wheel independent suspension system
- 17-inch alloy wheels with diamond-cut finish
- Automatic headlights with fog lights

This hybrid minivan is equipped with a 3.6L V6 engine paired with a continuously variable transmission, delivering a balance of capability and efficiency. The front-wheel-drive setup provides responsive handling while the heavy-duty suspension ensures a composed ride over varied road conditions. With automatic transmission, climate zone controls throughout the cabin maintain comfort for all passengers regardless of seating position.

The interior reflects a commitment to passenger comfort and convenience. Premium leather seating with memory functions allows drivers to set their preferred driving position, while heated and ventilated front seats adapt to seasonal conditions. The power driver and passenger seats offer easy access to optimal positioning, and the comprehensive climate system includes front dual-zone air conditioning paired with rear air conditioning and defroster capabilities.

Technology integration is seamless throughout the Pacifica Hybrid Limited. The Uconnect 5 navigation system features a prominent 10.1-inch touchscreen that supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, ensuring your smartphone integrates naturally with the vehicles ecosystem. The harman/kardon audio system with 20 speakers delivers quality sound, while SiriusXM 360L satellite radio access provides entertainment variety. Steering wheel-mounted controls keep essential functions within easy reach.

Safety is addressed through multiple layers of protection. The vehicle includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and brake assist work collaboratively to support confident driving in varying conditions. The rear backup camera provides visual confirmation when reversing, and low tire pressure monitoring alerts you to maintenance needs before they become problems.

The exterior presentation combines practicality with refined styling. The white paint is complemented by body-color bumpers, chrome and body-color exterior mirrors with heating elements and memory functions, and fog lights that improve visibility in adverse conditions. Rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to changing weather, while the 17-inch alloy wheels with diamond-cut finish and painted pockets add visual distinction.

Convenience features throughout the Pacifica Hybrid Limited make daily ownership straightforward. Remote keyless entry, illuminated entry, and heated door mirrors contribute to user-friendly operation. The power moonroof provides openness and light, while garage door transmitter integration offers seamless home integration. Storage solutions include driver and passenger door bins, overhead console, and the flexibility of three-row seating with split-folding capacity for cargo management.

description:
This 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L represents a practical choice for families and those who value versatility, comfort, and reliability in a minivan designed for everyday use and longer journeys.

- 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine with 9-Speed Automatic transmission
- 7-speaker SiriusXM audio system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Heated front bucket seats with leather trim
- Power moonroof
- Blind Spot Information System with Lane Keeping Assist
- Forward Collision Mitigation Braking System
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning
- Reclining 3rd row seat with split-folding rear seats
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear view
- Auto High-beam headlights with delay-off feature
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- HondaLink emergency communication system
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- 18" Dark Silver-Painted alloy wheels
- Power liftgate

The EX-L trim brings genuine comfort to family travel. Heated front seats wrapped in leather provide warmth during cold weather, while the power moonroof adds natural light and an open-air feel to the cabin. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading cargo, and climate zones keep front and rear passengers comfortable independently. Memory seat functions allow the driver to save preferred seating positions for quick recall.

Safety features work seamlessly to protect your family on every drive. The Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots, while the Lane Keeping Assist System helps keep you centered in your lane. Forward collision warning and mitigation braking provide additional protection, and the comprehensive airbag system includes front, side, and overhead coverage. Anti-lock brakes with brake assist and electronic stability control give you confident control in various driving conditions.

Technology integration keeps you connected without distraction. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility lets you access your smartphone's apps and services through the 160-watt audio system, while the HondaLink emergency communication system provides peace of mind. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and voice command functionality minimize the need to take your hands off the wheel.

The seating arrangement offers flexibility for passengers and cargo. With three rows and split-folding rear seats, you can reconfigure the interior to accommodate larger items when needed. The reclining third-row seat adds comfort for longer trips, and removable second-row seating maximizes your layout options. Front buckets with memory positioning let you find your ideal driving position instantly.

Fuel economy balances practicality with efficiency. At 19 city and 28 highway MPG, this Odyssey delivers reasonable performance for a vehicle in its class, making it suitable for both city errands and highway commuting. The nine-speed automatic transmission works to optimize power delivery and efficiency across various driving scenarios.

This 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L combines proven Honda reliability with thoughtful family features. Come experience how this minivan fits your lifestyle and transportation needs.

This 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L offers the reliability and versatility families depend on, presented in an attractive White Diamond Pearl finish that maintains its appeal and resale value.

- Power Liftgate
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Power moonroof
- 160-Watt AM/FM/HD/SiriusXM Audio System
- Blind Spot Information System
- Lane Keeping Assist System
- Forward Collision Mitigation Braking System
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Heated door mirrors with power adjustment
- Leather steering wheel and leather seat trim
- 18" Dark Silver-Painted Alloy wheels

The Odyssey EX-L delivers practical family transportation with a 3.5L V6 engine paired to a 9-speed automatic transmission. You'll appreciate the efficient fuel economy, achieving 19 MPG in city driving and 28 MPG on the highway. The spacious three-row interior accommodates up to seven passengers with flexibility to reconfigure cargo space as your needs change. Power windows, locks, and steering provide everyday convenience, while the power moonroof adds an open-air feel to your driving experience.

Safety features integrated throughout this minivan give you confidence on every journey. The Collision Mitigation Braking System works proactively to help prevent accidents, while Lane Keeping Assist provides guidance on the highway. Blind Spot Information warnings alert you to traffic you might otherwise miss. Six airbags, electronic stability control, and anti-lock brakes form a comprehensive safety foundation designed to protect your family.

This vehicle is certified, meaning it has undergone a comprehensive inspection and reconditioning process to meet Honda's exacting standards. A certified vehicle provides you with added peace of mind, backed by Honda's commitment to quality and performance.

The EX-L trim distinguishes itself with heated front bucket seats that offer comfort during cold months, while the power driver seat with memory settings allows you to save your preferred driving position. The automatic temperature control system maintains your desired cabin temperature effortlessly. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keep you connected safely through your smartphone, while the SiriusXM satellite radio system brings premium entertainment to every trip.

With power steering that responds smoothly to your input and four-wheel independent suspension engineered for a composed ride, this Odyssey handles everyday driving with refinement. The rear window wiper and speed-sensitive wipers ensure clear visibility in all weather conditions. Whether navigating city streets or traveling highway distances, this minivan provides the dependable performance families trust.

The 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L represents a practical investment in family transportation, combining proven Honda reliability with thoughtful amenities designed for your everyday comfort and convenience.

This 2019 Honda Odyssey Elite in white combines practical family transportation with refined comfort and safety features that make every journey more pleasant.

- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with leather trim

The Odyssey Elite prioritizes passenger comfort with its heated and ventilated front seats, three-zone climate control, and spacious seating configuration including a split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row seating. The power moonroof adds an open-air feel, while the heated steering wheel provides warmth during colder months. The comprehensive audio system delivers quality sound throughout the cabin, enhanced by convenient steering wheel-mounted controls and rear audio controls for passenger entertainment.

Safety technology is central to the Odyssey's design. The Collision Mitigation Braking System works with Forward Collision Warning to help reduce accident severity, while the Lane Keeping Assist System actively monitors lane position. The Blind Spot Information System provides additional awareness, and the backup camera assists with parking and reversing. Multiple airbags, including front and side impact protection, work alongside electronic stability control and traction control for comprehensive protection.

The navigation system helps you reach your destination confidently, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps your smartphone connected for navigation, communication, and entertainment. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading, particularly useful when your hands are full with passengers or cargo. Rain-sensing wipers and automatic headlights reduce driver distraction during varying weather conditions.

With 19 city miles per gallon and 28 highway miles per gallon, this Odyssey delivers reasonable fuel economy for its class and purpose. The eighteen-inch alloy wheels with all-season tires support the vehicle's responsive handling characteristics and complement its polished appearance.

This 2019 Odyssey Elite represents a mature minivan that addresses the practical needs of modern families while maintaining comfortable, feature-rich accommodations for daily driving and longer trips.

JUST ARRIVED. PENDING INSPECTION. Meet the 2018 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L, a carefully maintained minivan that delivers practical space and reliable performance for families on the go.

- Uconnect 4 infotainment system with 7" display and SiriusXM satellite radio
- Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto integration
- ParkView rear back-up camera
- Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection
- Heated front seats with perforated leather trim
- Power driver seat with armrest
- Rear air conditioning with dual zone climate control
- Front fog lights with automatic headlights
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- 17" aluminum alloy wheels
- Power liftgate

This vehicle is powered by a 3.6L V6 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive, delivering 19 miles per gallon in the city and 28 miles per gallon on the highway. The Touring L trim provides multiple layers of comfort and convenience features. The front seats feature heated leather trim and substantial cushioning, while power adjustments for the driver ensure you find the perfect driving position. Climate zones keep passengers comfortable throughout the cabin, from the dual-zone front system to dedicated rear air conditioning.

Safety receives proper attention with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel ABS brakes work together to maintain vehicle control in demanding driving conditions. The blind spot and cross path detection system provides added awareness when changing lanes or backing up, complemented by the ParkView rear back-up camera for parking situations.

Technology integration keeps you connected without distraction. The Uconnect 4 system with its 7-inch touchscreen provides straightforward access to navigation, climate controls, and vehicle settings. Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto compatibility means your smartphone functions work seamlessly through the vehicle's interface. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage calls and music without taking your hands off the wheel.

This Pacifica Touring L represents solid family transportation with proven reliability and the practical features that matter for daily driving and longer journeys.

Meet the 2017 Dodge Grand Caravan GT, a practical and capable family vehicle designed to serve your daily transportation needs with reliability and comfort.

- 40GB hard drive with 28GB available storage
- 9-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- 6.5-inch touchscreen display with Garmin navigation
- DVD-audio capability with CD player and AM/FM radio
- Front and rear dual-zone automatic temperature control
- Heated front and rear seats with leather trimming
- Power driver and passenger seats with adjustable positioning

The Grand Caravan GT is built around accommodating passengers and cargo with flexible seating arrangements. The second row features bucket seats with fold-in-floor functionality, while the third row provides split-bench seating for additional flexibility. Heated front and rear seats add comfort during colder months, and power-adjustable driver and passenger seating ensures everyone finds their ideal position.

The Garmin navigation system integrated into the 6.5-inch touchscreen provides reliable directions, while the SiriusXM satellite radio offers extensive programming options. With a 40GB hard drive offering 28GB of available storage, you can retain your music library for convenient access. Audio control options through the steering wheel allow you to adjust settings without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety systems work quietly in the background to protect your family. Dual front and front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags surround occupants with protection. Anti-whiplash front head restraints, electronic stability control, and traction control provide additional security, while the ParkView rear backup camera helps you navigate parking situations with confidence. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power.

The GT trim equips this van with practical features that enhance daily driving. The heated steering wheel, power liftgate, and illuminated entry points demonstrate attention to convenience. Exterior elements like body-color bumpers, heated door mirrors, and a rear window wiper contribute to both appearance and functionality. The 3.6L V6 24-valve engine delivers the power necessary for family driving, achieving 17 city and 25 highway MPG.

This 2017 Grand Caravan GT represents a solid opportunity for buyers seeking practical family transportation. Its combination of flexible seating, comprehensive safety features, and user-friendly technology addresses the core requirements of modern family vehicles. Visit our showroom to inspect this silver van and discover whether its practical design suits your transportation needs.
